attributes.title: 2027 SPA Convention & Workshops
attributes.series: SPA Annual Convention & Workshops (Society for Personality Assessment)
attributes.summary:
The Society for Personality Assessment holds its 2027 Annual Workshops and Convention March 31 to April 4, 2027, in Long Beach, California. The meeting brings together clinicians, researchers, educators and students who work in personality and psychological assessment, with pre-convention workshops followed by the main convention.

SPA is approved by the American Psychological Association to sponsor continuing education for psychologists, and is also a New York State Board for Psychology approved CE provider. The program, speakers, CE hours and registration fees for 2027 are not published yet; SPA says registration opens in the fall.

The convention page names The Westin Long Beach as the hotel, with room block details still to come. The call for proposals and sponsorship packages are already available on the convention page.
